brief.elevator_pitch: A cozy neighborhood coffee house in Seaside. Small-batch roasts, fresh pastries, friendly faces.
sample_phrases: Your cozy corner on the harbor

sonic_logo.prompt: Brand mnemonic for Harbor & Bean Coffee House (A cozy neighborhood coffee house in Seaside. Small-batch roasts, fresh pastries, friendly faces.). A 4-second sonic logo in the spirit of the Netflix ta-dum or Intel bong: warm acoustic, warm, welcoming mood, warm, cozy, friendly, welcoming character. Opens with a soft attack, rises through two or three notes, resolves to a single warm chord that rings out cleanly. Ownable, hummable, unmistakable. No vocals, no speech.
sonic_logo.negative_prompt: vocals, speech, muddy mix, harsh noise, long fade

voice_logo.script: Welcome to Harbor and Bean Coffee House. A cozy neighborhood coffee house in Seaside.
voice_logo.voice_direction: Speak as the brand's own voice: warm, natural speaking voice. Tone: warm, cozy, friendly, welcoming. Unhurried, one breath, smile audible.

notification.prompt: Soft notification chime for Harbor & Bean Coffee House: warm acoustic, warm, welcoming. A single gentle wooden knock followed by a warm muted tone, under one second, friendly not urgent.

success.prompt: Success confirm for Harbor & Bean Coffee House: warm acoustic, warm, welcoming. Two rising notes resolving up, bright but soft, under 1.2 seconds.

error.prompt: Gentle error nudge for Harbor & Bean Coffee House: warm acoustic, warm, welcoming. A single low rounded tone, no buzz, no harshness, under one second. Reassuring, not alarming.

music.note: Set FAL_API_KEY to generate sonic logos and UI sounds; until then the sonic_brand skill stages briefs + prompts.
